initial_obs: • Wound flushed with saline and inspected for any venous (dark red) or arterial (bright red) blood seeping through the wound: {bleeding_observation}
if_vascular: • Dil-Iodine applied to the skin around the wound.
• A sterile scalpel was utilized to make an incision on either side of the wound in order to gain access to the damaged {vessel}.
• Sterile hemostats were applied to either side of the damaged {vessel} (proximally, and then distally).
remove_bullet: • Sterile forceps were utilized to remove the bullet, which was successful and came out whole.
close: • C-hook was resterilized and rethreaded with {injury_thread} and a {injury_suture} pattern was utilized to suture the wound closed. Held well
